description: Execute a real x402-protected InstaVeil Instagram data API via MCP. First call without payment returns a free x402 V2 PaymentRequired structuredContent quote (isError=true). After a buyer wallet authorizes the exact Solana USDC payment, retry tools/call with the same arguments and params._meta['x402/payment'] containing its signed PaymentPayload (or payment_signature for clients without x402-over-MCP support). Verified data and payment settlement receipt follow as structuredContent and _meta['x402/payment-response']. No keys, automatic charges or simulated sales.

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 V2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE supplied by buyer's authorized Solana USDC wallet; omit to obtain a free 402 quote.

name: execute_paid_product
